cohort: 383 pregnant women (192 with GDM and 191 with NGT)
finding: Beta cell dysfunction, rather than insulin resistance, appears to be a key factor in GDM development in this Chinese population, with impaired insulin secretion being associated with various adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The IFG subgroup of GDM had a 2.319 times higher risk of cesarean section compared to the NGT group.
